artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. Michael Schlossberg
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch of a man's upper body, focusing on his profile from the shoulders up. He has strong facial features including a prominent nose and slightly furrowed brow. His hair is curly and textured, with a beard or sideburns to match. The man is dressed formally in a dark coat with a collar. The background is plain, and there is a signature and some writing in the bottom left corner of the sketch.

artworks.title: Untitled (Girl with Bird of Paradise)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Christopher and Beverly With in memory of Karl and Gerda With
artworks.description: The image displays a monochromatic composition with bold, angular lines and contrasting shades, forming the basis of an abstract artwork. The shapes create visual tension, with sharp, triangular forms intersected by diagonal lines. A circular motif is seen in the upper sections, while ornamental flourishes and spirals decorate the bottom. The inclusion of familiar elements alongside geometric abstractions creates a juxtaposition within the artwork.

artworks.title: At the Gate (Am Thor)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Christopher and Beverly With in memory of Karl and Gerda With
artworks.description: Two figures are depicted near an ornate gate. One figure is bent over, peering through the gate, and the other figure stands next to them. The man has short hair and facial hair, and the woman has her hair styled upwards. She is dressed in a long, fitted dress with buttons and ruffles. The man and woman are surrounded by foliage, and there is a single shoe on the ground. The gate is intricately decorated, and there is a partially visible building in the background.

artworks.title: Rape II (Raub II, Weib halb)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Christopher and Beverly With in memory of Karl and Gerda With
artworks.description: The image features flowing lines and soft curves, creating an abstract composition that suggests human figures. The rounded shapes and lines evoke the impression of two individuals, one standing and one kneeling, engaged in an interaction that resembles an embrace.

artworks.title: Temperantia (Temperance)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Christopher and Beverly With in memory of Karl and Gerda With
artworks.description: The image depicts a person sitting on an ornate, curved piece of furniture, pouring liquid from a vessel in their left hand into a bowl held by their right hand. The person has soft facial features, long wavy hair, and wears a red cloth draped over their shoulders. The background shows a blend of architectural and natural elements, including arches and green and earthy tones. A textured section in the background resembles a wall or fresco. In one corner, the word "TEMP[T]ER ANTIA" is inscribed.

artworks.title: Nude IX
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Christopher and Beverly With in memory of Karl and Gerda With
artworks.description: This print consists of bold, angular lines and shapes that create the outlines of two human figures standing amidst a collection of curved and straight lines resembling tree trunks and leaves. Both people appear to be nude and have curves on their chests, suggesting breasts. The person on the left is seated, with one arm over their head and resting on the opposite shoulder. The person on the right is standing in profile, facing the left, and their face is covered by their bent arm. Small lines give a minimal impression of facial details, like sharp eyebrows, straight noses, and small mouths. The trees surrounding the two people appear to have thin trunks with round shapes at the top. The background is filled with curving leaves or rocks. The lines in the print are thick and black against tan paper.

artworks.title: Venus and Cupid
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 5.7 × 9.2 cm (2 1/4 × 3 5/8 in.)
sheet: 10.1 × 15 cm (4 × 5 7/8 in.) (irregular)
artworks.creditLine: Katharine Shepard Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a reclining female figure with a standing child-like figure. The woman is lying on her back with her head slightly raised, draped in flowing cloth. She has long hair and a serene expression. The smaller figure is standing on one leg, appearing to support itself on the woman, with curly hair and holding a bow. They both rest on billowing clouds, suggesting a celestial setting. The background features textured lines, creating a cloudy or heavenly environment. The scene is enclosed within an oval border.

artworks.title: Horace's Sabine Villa
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with mountains, a carriage, figures, trees, and a cliff with a structure on its top. The scene includes detailed engravings showcasing texture and depth. The artwork uses an etching technique with intricate lines and cross-hatching to create monochromatic sepia tones.

artworks.title: Sleeping Bacchantes
artworks.creditLine: Gift of David H. McDonnell
artworks.description: This is a painting depicting a woodland scene with putti and a reclining figure draped in flowing fabrics. The background includes lush trees and a bright blue sky, with small winged figures resembling cherubs frolicking among themselves. An urn is situated nearby with intricate detailing. The style is reminiscent of François Boucher's ornate and playful Rococo themes, and the overall mood is dreamlike with soft pastel tones.

artworks.title: Norman Stairway, Canterbury
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro

artworks.title: Barbizon Roadway in Snow
artworks.creditLine: Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a snow-covered landscape with a winding path leading into the distance. The horizon is obscured by a line of leafless trees and dense shrubbery. Several trees with bare branches and snow-laden evergreens are visible. The trees and path show intricate texture, with fine detail in the snow and branches. The color palette is monochromatic and utilizes a sepia tone, giving the scene a vintage and serene effect.

artworks.title: Gorges de Franchard - Forêt de Fontainebleau (Franchard Gorges – Fontainebleau Forest)
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing on a large rock formation, viewed from below. The sky fills the upper part of the image, contrasting with the detailed textures of the rocks which display various natural lines and crevices. The color palette is mainly brown and gray, emphasizing the rocky landscape. Sparse vegetation can be seen among the rocks.

artworks.title: Rome, Vue Prise au Forum (Rome, View of the Forum)
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: The image depicts a view of ancient ruins. In the foreground are towering classical columns, with a row of them on the left side. The scene shows a path lined with historic structures and ruins extending into the background. The composition is from a slightly elevated angle. The horizon is high in the frame, overlooking the ruins and cityscape. The color palette is a monochromatic sepia tone. In the distance, faint outlines of hills or mountains can be seen.

artworks.title: The Pyramids of Saqqara from the North-East
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Diana and Mallory Walker
artworks.description: The image shows an arid landscape with two pyramids. The point of view is slightly elevated, showing the terrain leading to the pyramids. The horizon line is high, emphasizing the sandy landscape. One pyramid is rough and made of stacked stones, while the other is larger with a stepped structure. The color palette is monochrome, highlighting the textures and forms of the pyramids and the sandy ground. The sky occupies the upper half of the image. In the foreground, there are patches of sand and small mounds of stone.

artworks.title: Bas-Breau, Forest of Fontainebleau
artworks.creditLine: Patrons’ Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a ground-level view of a narrow path lined with trees in a densely wooded area. The path leads towards a lighter area in the distance. The trees form a canopy overhead, partially blocking the sky. The scene has a sepia tone with muted browns and light shades. Earthy tones are prominent, creating a timeless and tranquil atmosphere. Sunlight filters through the trees, casting dappled patterns on the path.

artworks.title: Brig on the Water
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Diana and Mallory Walker
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view of the sea extending towards the horizon. A ship with prominent sails sails on the distant curved horizon. Dramatic clouds fill the sky, contrasting with patches of sunlight. The color palette is primarily sepia, giving a vintage feel. The sea below is calm with gentle ripples and reflects the sky's light.

artworks.title: Effet de Givre (The Effect of Frost)
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: The image contains a ground-level view of a frosty landscape. The foreground shows frost-covered grass and small shrubs, creating a textured surface. In the center, there is a brick structure with a stepped, pyramid-like design, and to the right is a building with visible triangular gable ends. Beyond the buildings, there are leafless trees against a bright sky. The horizon is marked by a line of frosted trees and shrubs in the distance. The overall palette is monochrome, emphasizing shades of brown and grey to enhance the wintry and desolate feel of the scene.

artworks.title: Cloud Study over the Pantheon, Paris
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Diana and Mallory Walker
artworks.description: The image depicts a cityscape with a prominent dome structure slightly to the right of the center. The horizon is near the bottom of the image, while the city sprawls out low across the scene. The sky is filled with large clouds illuminated by a soft light, adding texture and contrast to the upper part of the image. The colors are a sepia tone, giving the photograph a warm, brownish tint. The composition is balanced by the silhouette of the dome against the sky, with smoke or cloud wisps adding movement above the buildings.

artworks.title: Arlesiennes dans le Cloître de Saint-Trophime (Women from Arles in the Cloisters of Saint Trophime)
artworks.creditLine: Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows two women in full-length, dressed in period clothing. One woman is standing, leaning against a carved stone structure with her one arm holding up a portion of her long dark dress. Her other arm is bent, resting on her hips. She wears a white bonnet, white apron, and a scarf-like accessory around her shoulders. The other woman is seated, turned slightly to the side with her hands folded in her lap. She wears a dark dress, white apron, and a bonnet. The background consists of architectural elements that appear ancient or in a classical design, featuring columns and arches, with intricate carvings and textures on the stone. The scene is set in an exterior location, possibly an ancient ruin, with shadows suggesting an afternoon light.

artworks.title: Nature Morte: chaudron, cruche et legumes, sur une table a tretaux (Still Life: Pot, Pitcher and Vegetables on a Sawhorse Table)
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: A wooden table covered with vegetables and a basket tipped over on the ground to the left. A large pitcher and metal pot are visible. The color palette consists of sepia tones. The table is positioned centrally with a backdrop of a brick wall and scattered foliage, while a cobblestone path runs across the bottom right.

artworks.title: Assembly of Troops for Napoleon III, Place Bellecour de Lyon
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Diana and Mallory Walker
artworks.description: The image shows an overhead view of a busy urban square with people and horse-drawn carriages. In the middle, there is a grand equestrian statue on a pedestal surrounded by scaffolding and fountains. The background features a row of multi-story buildings and hills in the distance. The image has a sepia tone, soft lighting, and a grainy texture, evoking a vintage aesthetic.

artworks.title: Jérusalem: Église de Sainte Marie Madeleine (Jerusalem: Church of St. Mary Magdalene)
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: The image displays an ancient ruin from an elevated perspective. The horizon is high, with a sloping hill covered in scattered vegetation. The stone ruins, walls, rubble, and overgrown areas are visible. The stones look weathered, with a grayscale color palette, creating a historical appearance. The composition leads the eye from the stonework to the distant landscape.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Young Woman
artworks.artist: Albert Sands Southworth and Josiah Johnson Hawes
artworks.creditLine: Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman from the waist up, positioned slightly angled to the right with her head turned to the left. Her facial features are delicate with a composed expression, arched eyebrows, and dark eyes. Her hair is styled in large rolls on either side, possibly with extensions, framing her face elegantly. She is dressed in a richly textured garment with an intricately designed lace shawl draped over her shoulders. Her clothing has detailed embroidery. She holds a delicate handheld fan with both hands in front of her. She wears circular earrings and a brooch at the neck of her dress. The background is plain and dark, contrasting with her clothing. The photograph is set within a vintage frame with an ornate gold border.

artworks.title: Winter Trees, Reflected in a Pond
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: This sepia-toned photograph features tall, bare trees lining a body of water. In the lower half of the photograph, the reflection of the trees and the pale sky can be seen in the water.
